name: Vitalpinum Thal-Assling
kurzbeschreibung: The Vitalpinum in Thal-Assling (Osttirol): 7,000 m² Alpine wellness park with a historic mountain pine oil distillery, barefoot path, and herb garden.
beschreibung:
Overview

The Vitalpinum is a unique Alpine experience park and a sanctuary for Alpine naturopathy located in the hamlet of Thal within the Osttirol municipality of Assling. Situated on a sunny terrace in the Hochpustertal at an altitude of approximately 800 metres, the expansive wellness and show garden extends over more than 7,000 square metres right along the Drau river. The park combines a more than 130-year tradition of mountain pine oil distillation with a contemporary nature adventure park that engages all five human senses and brings the healing powers of Alpine mountain flora to life.

Route & Requirements

The origins of the Vitalpinum trace back to the renowned Tyrolean natural remedy enterprise Brüder Unterweger, which established Tyrol's first mountain pine oil distillery in the Pustertal as early as 1886. The world-famous essential dwarf mountain pine oil is extracted through gentle steam distillation from the needles and branches of the high-alpine dwarf pine (Pinus mugo), hand-harvested in the Lienzer Dolomiten. The centrepiece of the park is the historic show pine oil distillery, where visitors can experience the traditional distillation process in copper cauldrons up close. In the spacious Alpine garden, interactive discovery stations invite relaxation: a diverse barefoot sensory path made of river pebbles, fir cones, and wood rounds stimulates foot reflex zones, while a fragrant herb labyrinth presents rare medicinal herbs of the Eastern Alps such as arnica, St. John's wort, and edelweiss. Highlights also include the wooden Latschenkrone treehouse, Kneipp water-treading pools with ice-cold mountain spring water, a refreshing aroma mist trail, and an open-air inhalatorium infused with pure stone pine and dwarf pine extracts.

Visit & Arrival

The Vitalpinum Thal is open daily during the summer months from early May to late October from 09:30 to 18:00 (until 18:30 in July and August). Admission prices (2025/2026 season): adults approx. €8.50, seniors approx. €7.50, children and teenagers (6 to 15 years) approx. €4.50, infants under 6 years enjoy free admission; family ticket approx. €19.00. Admission is free with the regional Osttirol Card. Access to the adjoining natural cosmetics shop is free of charge. Arrival by car: Via the Drautalstraße B100 between Lienz and Sillian to Thal-Assling; large free parking lots are available directly on site. By public transport: ÖBB trains (Pustertalbahn) to Thal station, followed by an easy five-minute flat walk to the park entrance. Cyclists can reach the Vitalpinum directly via the Drauradweg R1 cycle path.

Tips

The entire park grounds are flat and step-free; the main pathways are wide, gravelled, and easily passable for wheelchairs and pushchairs. Bring a small towel to dry your feet after using the Kneipp water pools and the barefoot path. In the on-site shop, you can purchase freshly distilled mountain pine oil and certified organic arnica ointments directly from the producer.
